execution_design.one_continue_scope: Once a future surviving MBES tranche is governed-started, one owner Continue carries that tranche through implementation, required validation, verified closeout, and next-tranche selection unless an OPS3 owner-only boundary or genuine external blocker is reached.
execution_design.preload_rule: Load only the selected surviving tranche and its declared dependency closure; block unrelated roadmap, benchmark and source archaeology.
execution_design.closeout_rule: Reserve at least 8 minutes of the 24-minute tranche target for focused validation, durable-evidence verification, reconciliation, and successor marking.
execution_design.split_rule: If the selected tranche cannot credibly leave the closeout reserve intact, split it before governed start rather than overrunning the tranche.
execution_design.retry_rule: Do not rerun an unchanged deterministic failure; classify the failure and require changed evidence before retry.

boundaries: MBES is the player/GM built-environment and settlement gameplay/orchestration layer; it does not replace canonical World, Environment, Character, Inventory, Economy, Project, Action/Event, Settlement or organization owners
MIB-14 retains vehicle/platform/base/facility definition and deterministic foundation authority; MBES composes accepted foundations into playable construction and settlement loops

MERA retains generic engineering topology, interfaces, dependency/failure, diagnostics, repair/refit and network semantics; reduced MBES implements building/infrastructure domain adapters rather than a second engineering engine
MCS retains cartographic geometry, map/interior authoring and presentation authority; drawing or editing geometry never silently commits construction or World truth
MRCS retains reusable construction materials, component, facility, blueprint and rules/content-definition authority
APW/D26 retains durable Project/task and campaign-time authority; construction labor, schedules and phases commit through owner-approved Project operations

MIB-12 retains crafting/transformation/repair transaction authority; MIB-13/Economy retains prices, markets, contracts, property/economic truth; MBES consumes references/adapters rather than duplicating either ledger

ICF retains cultivation/production definitions and Inventory/Asset retains stored-item truth; historical MBES-11 production work is reduced to facility capability/network bindings and settlement capacity projections

Character/MNCS, ODL and DPL retain people, household/crew/organization, jobs/profession/schedule truth; historical MBES-17 is reduced to facility-use/staffing prerequisite and settlement-capacity bindings
PCA-12 and PDCP Packet 08 retain generic simulation/formal/flow/capacity analysis; MBES implements only built-environment model adapters and domain interpretation
GPR plus Action/Event retain generic gameplay execution/replay; PDCP Packet 07 retains shared preview/commit/explanation/intervention/recovery semantics
World, Environment, Reality/Branch and related owners define canonical gravity, atmosphere, climate, ecology, magic/technology laws, terrain/world state, sentience and world-response behavior

MBES may emit explicit construction/extraction/pollution/habitat/density/resource externality observations or accepted Events and consume owner-authorized World/Environment responses; unrelated-domain fan-out routes through reduced MSWI rather than direct MBES mutation
Oara's planetary sentience response to pollution and over-development is proven through the same generic reactive-world owner interface available to other living/spiritual/machine/divine worlds

construction-resolution levels remain distinct and may summarize or expand without duplicate canonical identity: settlement/district → site/parcel → structure → level/zone → space/room → component/fixture → connection/network

functional room/facility classification is capability-derived from accepted components, networks, access, staffing prerequisites and environment conditions where owner rules support it; labels alone do not create capabilities
network automation is bounded condition→authorized-operation orchestration and never becomes unrestricted scripting or autonomous GM/human decision authority
structural, utility, ecology and city analysis are game-rule simulations rather than real-world engineering/safety claims; unsupported facts remain unresolved
MSLR remains the specialist successor after MBES-24 for non-standard spatial-law gameplay; MBES provides accepted built spaces but does not become the impossible-space runtime
optional AI remains visibility-safe advisory/presentation only and cannot silently place, demolish, spend, pollute, relocate residents, change ownership, publish or mutate canonical state
all reusable assets, blueprints, prefabs, imported models and derivatives preserve ARI/PCA identity, rights and provenance
no paid/cloud provider is required for blocking construction, simulation, validation, blueprint or settlement workflows
proprietary benchmark products remain clean-room planning provenance only; protected source, assets, distinctive UI expression, maps, save formats and private protocols are not copied
no MBES implementation authority exists until a future OPS3 CURRENT.json governed start selects a specific surviving MBES work item
